card.name: Digits inside page numbers and ranges
card.fires_on: A single digit inside a multi-digit number, most often the start or end page in a journal citation such as 579–87. It also fires on digits in volume or issue numbers, and occasionally in temperatures or percentages.

modes.label: Citation page numbers
modes.description: A digit in the page range, volume or article number of a journal reference.

modes.label: Digits in measurements
modes.description: A digit within a temperature or percentage in label text.

card.writes: Weak output effect; the promoted tokens are mostly identifier-like pieces such as uid, cid and PMC, which suggests reference-style text.
card.plain: It fires on a digit in the middle of a number, mainly page numbers in a journal reference list.
